about: Settings of the confirming run 'everyday-v2': 480 Tasks that no earlier run and no replay has read (same eight kinds as everyday-v1, new items). Nothing here is a result. Same models and prompt as bench_spec_everyday.json. The plugin arms run the final frozen copy of the plugin.
prompt_suffix: Work through it step by step. Then end your reply with one last line in this form: Answer: <the number, or the letter of the option>

phases.title: Learning phase
phases.about: 240 Tasks, 30 of each of eight kinds. Continuum starts with an empty record file and is never told a kind.

phases.title: Test phase
phases.about: 240 other Tasks of the same eight kinds. Continuum keeps the records of the learning phase. This phase carries the headline figures.

A-own-model.about: Hermes with the user's own (larger) model for every Task. Continuum is not loaded.

A2-own-model-repeat.about: A second pass of arm A: the same model, the same Tasks, no plugin. The difference between A and A2 is the run-to-run noise of one model at temperature 0.2; a plugin arm is read against it.

B-small-model.about: Hermes with the small model for every Task. Continuum is not loaded.

C-marked.about: Continuum on, default settings. After every turn the harness marks the answer good or bad with the plugin's own /continuum command, from the answer key. This stands for a user who marks every turn.

D-self-checked.about: Continuum on, nobody marks anything. The user's own model checks every turn that the small model answered (one PASS or FAIL question). The answer key is used only to score the run afterwards.

tasks_are: checkable Tasks (half are four easy kinds written by `make_everyday_v2_items.py` from a fixed seed, half are four harder kinds from public sets)
answer_key_is: the answer key (from the generating code for the easy kinds, from the public set for the others)
